br.stealth_on_tip: ANONYMOUS browsing active: traffic via Tor (hidden IP) and no local traces. Click to disable.

cs.acq_intro: Choose the device to acquire. It is copied in E01 format, which embeds the case data and hashes into the image, and is then re-verified.
cs.exhibit_ph: e.g. internal disk of the seized laptop
cs.intro: Every operation is logged automatically in the chain of custody with UTC time, tool and hash: the record does not depend on what you remember to note. Disks stay write-protected throughout the acquisition.
cs.missing_data_body: Name and operator are mandatory: without them the report cannot be attributed to anyone.
cs.no_case_body: Create or open a case before proceeding: without a case there is no chain of custody to log the operations.
cs.no_image_body: This case has no acquired images yet. Run step 1 first, or open a case that contains some.
cs.notes_intro: Notes go into the chain of custody with a timestamp: they explain the choices made (why a disk was excluded, where it was found, who was present).
cs.report_intro: The report gathers the case data, exhibits with their hashes, the full chain of custody, partitions and timeline. It is a self-contained HTML file: it opens anywhere and prints to PDF from the browser.
cs.select_device_above: Select the device in the list above.
cs.start_acq_body:
The following run in sequence: write protection, E01 copy, hash verification, analysis (partitions and timeline) and report generation.

On a large disk the operation can take hours. The window stays usable.
cs.title: Forensic cases
dk.copy_started: Copy started in a terminal window.
dk.intro: Disks are always visible, but they are NEVER mounted automatically: NexusSec is also a forensic distro. Mounting is always your explicit choice and happens READ-ONLY, unless you ask otherwise.
dk.mount_rw_body:
The disk content will be modifiable. On a disk under examination this alters its state and may compromise its evidentiary value.

If you only need to read, cancel and use "Mount read-only".
dk.title: Disks

sec.fw_unknown: Firewall state unreadable without a password: manage it from the Control Center.

v.ac.arc_dark_desc: Dark Arc-style variant with round traffic lights (adapted from Lubuntu Arc-Round, GPL-3). Fixed theme, does not follow the profile.
v.ac.arc_light_desc: Light Arc-style variant with round traffic lights (adapted from Lubuntu Arc-Round, GPL-3). Fixed theme, does not follow the profile.
v.ac.cards_desc: Traffic-light buttons on the left (close/minimize/maximize) with the symbol inside, rounded corners (picom). Border and title follow the profile colour. Enables a compositor only while selected.
v.ac.core_desc: Our dark HUD with cyan accent. Fixed, does not change with the profile.
v.ac.retro_desc: Light flat theme derived from «1977». Follows the active profile colour.
v.ac.title: Coordinated appearance
v.ac_intro: Choose the window-theme FAMILY and the terminal prompt style. «Retro» and «Cards» automatically follow the active operational profile's colour.
v.ac_note: For a specific, non-coordinated Openbox theme (e.g. one of the «1977») use «Window themes».
v.ai.cloud_warn: Warning: with the cloud the context (questions, pasted output) goes out to an external service. Use an endpoint you trust. The key stays only in ~/.config/nxs/ai.json (permissions 600).
v.ai.consent: I authorise sending the context to the cloud service
v.ai.exec_help: If enabled, in the conversation (nxs-ai) you can run a proposed command: it shows it, asks for confirmation and launches it in a sandbox (bubblewrap), respecting the profile. Destructive or on-disk commands are always blocked.
v.ai.exec_toggle: Allow running the proposed commands (always with confirmation, sandboxed)
v.ai.intro: NexusSec advisory assistant: it answers and PROPOSES commands, it does not run them (Phase 1). Choose where the model runs. Nothing is downloaded without an explicit action from you.
v.ai.model_ph: Cloud model, e.g. gpt-4o-mini / your AIos name
v.ai.runtime_not_installed: Runtime not installed. Press the button to install it (apk add ollama).
v.ai.saved_hint: Settings saved. Open the conversation with the button below or from the terminal with: nxs-ai
v.ai.title: AI assistant
v.autostart.title: Autostart
v.autostart_intro: Programs started with the session. Tick to enable, type the command, then press Save. System entries (wallpaper, panel, desktop) are managed separately.
v.autostart_saved:
Autostart entries saved in:
%s

They take effect at the next session start.
v.bt.name: Name
v.bt.title: Bluetooth management
v.bt_none_scan: No devices. Press «Scan devices» to look for new ones.
v.bt_recv_on: Reception active: send from your phone to this PC.
v.bt_send_fail_check: Send failed: check the device is paired and reachable, then try again. (%s)
v.bt_send_fail_obexd: Send failed: obexd does not start (see /tmp/nxs-bt-obex.log).
v.bt_vm_hint: Not available in a VM: use a USB dongle.
v.dclick_applied: Applied now: %d ms, %d px. Try again above.
v.dclick_speed_help: Milliseconds within which the two clicks must arrive. The higher it is, the easier the double-click, but the system waits that time before concluding it was a single click.
v.dclick_try: Try below: do a double-click or a double-tap.
v.fetch_desc: Show the logo and system info when the terminal opens
v.fw.title: Firewall
v.fw_intro: nftables firewall. Policy: OUTBOUND traffic free (tools must be able to go out), INBOUND traffic blocked except the ports you open here. To listen with a handler/reverse shell, open the port or disable temporarily.
v.hk_intro: Openbox «run command» shortcuts. Edit the command with a double-click; use the buttons to change the key, add or remove. Changes apply immediately (openbox --reconfigure).
v.hotkeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
v.kbd_desc: Keyboard layout for the graphical session.
v.kbd_press: Press a key: the mapping appears here.
v.kbd_test_hint: Type here to check the characters match the keys:
v.kbd_test_ph: e.g. è à ù ò ì @ # \ | accented keys...
v.keyboard.title: Keyboard
v.lang.desc: NexusSec interface language. The change applies immediately to the panel; already-open windows (including this Control Center) must be reopened to see them in the new language.
v.lang.set_msg: Language set. The panel restarts; reopen the other windows to apply it everywhere.
v.lang.title: Language
v.logs.title: System logs
v.menu.title: Right-click menu (Openbox)
v.monitor.title: Resource monitor
v.mouse.title: Mouse and touchpad
v.mouse_intro: GTK recognizes a double-click only if the two clicks fall within a time AND stay within a distance. With a finger on the touchpad it's the distance that breaks first: that's why a fast double-tap can fail while a slow one works.
v.move_tol_help: How many pixels the pointer may move between the two clicks. With a mouse 5 is enough; with a finger you need more.
v.no_pw_set: No password set: set one to enable the lock.
v.obtheme.title: Window themes (Openbox)
v.obtheme_intro: Window borders and decorations. Double-click to apply.
v.panel_intro:
GTK3 bar with icons, as wide as the screen, dockable at the
bottom or top. Left: NexusSec menu and launchers (Terminal,
Files, Center). Middle: the list of open windows (click to
activate, click the active window to minimize it). Right:
clock and "show desktop" button.

The edge space is reserved by Openbox (rc.xml) so that
maximized windows do not cover the panel.

v.pkg.search_ph: Search an Alpine package (e.g. nmap, ripgrep)...

v.press_combo:
Press the desired combination…
(Esc to cancel)
v.priv.anon_desc: All traffic via Tor (transparent) + kill-switch: no leaks. UDP and IPv6 disabled.
v.priv.mac_desc: Locally-administered random MAC: hardware can't be tracked across networks.
v.priv.panic_body: The PC shuts down immediately securing the data (encryption key out of RAM, caches flushed). Open windows will NOT be saved.
v.priv.panic_desc: If you remove the boot stick, the PC shuts down securing the data (LUKS key out of RAM). Removable media only.
v.priv.panic_usb: Panic if you remove the USB stick
v.priv.tor_desc: Routes proxy-aware apps through Tor (HORUS, stealth browser).
v.prompt_set: Prompt «%s» set. Open a new terminal to see it.
v.pt.title: Panel theme (bar and menu)
v.pt_intro: Colours of bar, menu and popups. «Follow the profile» uses the active profile colour (default); the other skins have fixed colours, independent of the profile. You can add your own skins by leaving a .css file in ~/.config/nxs/panel-themes/.
v.pw_first: Set a password first to enable the lock.
v.pw_min4: The password must be at least 4 characters.
v.pw_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
v.screens.title: Displays
v.screens_intro: Displays: extend, duplicate or use a single screen; the resolution applies to the selected output.
v.screens_on_connect: At boot and when a monitor is connected:
v.screensaver.title: Screensaver
v.sec.intro: State of the system's defenses. The live system is convenient and ephemeral; once INSTALLED on disk you can harden it (password, no autologin, doas with password, screen lock, encrypted persistence).
v.sec.title: Security and hardening
v.size_applied: Height and icons applied. Panel restarted.
v.ss_intro: NexusSec animated screensaver: starts after a period of inactivity and closes on any movement or key.
v.sysinfo.title: System information
v.theme_installed_pick: «%s» installed. Select it and press Apply.
v.theme_sys_noremove: «%s» is installed system-wide and cannot be removed from here.
v.users.title: User management
v.users_intro: System users. On the live system the default user is «nexus» with password «nexus» (Kali style): change it here. Changes are permanent only if the system is installed or with persistence.
v.vdesk_info: You now have %d virtual desktops. The switcher appears in the left of the bar (if more than one).
v.wall_intro: Choose the wallpaper. It is independent of the profile and the panel skin: it stays until you change it or press «Back to profile wallpaper».
v.wallpaper.title: Desktop wallpaper
v.ws.flat_desc: Dark cards with soft corners and a light accent edge. Sober and restful: it's the classic NexusSec style.
v.ws.frame_desc: Near-black background, elements defined by the accent border and a side bar. Terminal/cyber aesthetic, very technical.
v.ws.glass_desc: Accent veil, coloured top rule and striped texture in the header. Elegant, "operations console". (default)
v.ws.real_desc: TRULY translucent windows with background blur, like the Windows glass/acrylic effect. Turns on the compositor (picom): on a VM with software graphics it can be heavier.
v.ws.title: Window style
v.ws_applied: Style «%s» applied. Already-open windows update when reopened.
v.ws_intro: Choose how to dress the desktop windows. The style matches the active profile's accent and applies to the Control Center, views and dialogs.
